services.desc: Enjoy a magnificent flight over the Florida Keys to the city of Key West. It is a fun loving town known for its delicious local cuisine. Once there, you can take in the sights of Old Town, visit Mallory Square, The Aquarium, Duval Street, shop, hop on a jet ski, and have lunch at 5 star Sunset Key Resort and so much more. services.desc: You will enjoy a beautiful flight over Aventura, Gulfstream Park, Golden Beach, Sunny Isles Beach, Haulover Beach, and Hard Rock Stadium. This tour will fly you over Haulover Park to the shoreline where you will see Miami Beach, South Beach, South Point, Star Island, and Hard Rock Stadium. Enjoy an amazing ride over the beautiful beaches of Miami Beach, South Beach, and Fisher Island. blurb: Guests fly in air conditioned luxury helicopters over scenic Miami Beach, South Beach, Key Biscayne, Downtown Miami, and Fort Lauderdale. They can also charter flights to destinations like Key West, Orlando, and the Bahamas. Specialty flights include aerial photography, video, and private events like weddings and proposals.
